يشترعون (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِعُونَ (yaštariʕūna) /jaʃ.ta.ri.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
# يُشْتَرَعُونَ (yuštaraʕūna) /juʃ.ta.ra.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَعَ (ištaraʕa)
